items.title: Houston Person Part 1 interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995…
items.q: they were great jazz musicians when I met them — Eddie Harris, Cedar Walton, Leo Wright, Don Menza.

ctx.x: Was I correct in reading that during the military service you got to play with quite a few people that later on became good jazz musicians also?
Oh, yeah, well they were great jazz musicians when I met them — Eddie Harris, Cedar Walton, Leo Wright, Don Menza. © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-
